elements.requirement: A pregnant woman, or a person with whom a pregnant woman resides or might reasonably be expected to reside, has a priority need for accommodation.
elements.quote: a pregnant woman or a person with whom she resides or might reasonably be expected to reside

elements.requirement: A person with whom dependent children reside or might reasonably be expected to reside has a priority need for accommodation.
elements.quote: a person with whom dependent children reside or might reasonably be expected to reside

elements.requirement: A person who is vulnerable as a result of old age, mental illness, handicap, physical disability, or other special reason, or a person with whom such a vulnerable person resides or might reasonably be expected to reside, has a priority need for accommodation.
elements.quote: a person who is vulnerable as a result of old age, mental illness or handicap or physical disability or other special reason, or with whom such a person resides or might reasonably be expected to reside

elements.requirement: A person who is homeless or threatened with homelessness as a result of an emergency such as flood, fire, or other disaster has a priority need for accommodation.
elements.quote: a person who is homeless or threatened with homelessness as a result of an emergency such as flood, fire or other disaster

elements.requirement: A person who is homeless as a result of being a victim of domestic abuse has a priority need for accommodation.
elements.quote: a person who is homeless as a result of that person being a victim of domestic abuse

elements.requirement: The Secretary of State may by order specify further descriptions of persons as having a priority need for accommodation.
elements.quote: specify further descriptions of persons as having a priority need for accommodation

elements.requirement: The Secretary of State may by order amend or repeal any part of subsection (1) of section 189 of the Housing Act 1996.
elements.quote: amend or repeal any part of subsection (1)

elements.requirement: Before making an order under subsection (2), the Secretary of State must consult such associations representing relevant authorities, and such other persons, as the Secretary of State considers appropriate.

elements.requirement: No order under subsection (2) may be made unless a draft of the order has been approved by resolution of each House of Parliament.
